messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the cache meltdown postmortem. We need owners for immediate remediation and a plan to track recurrence. I sketched assignments below, please ACK or edit.

Dan: ACK. I'll own infra fixes + deployment (RED-6342). ETA 3d. Will prepare canary script.

Rohit: I'll take the runtime config cleanup and the rollback doc (RED-6343). ETA 4d. Will add perf regression checks.

Tara: I'll own monitoring, alert tuning, and dashboards (RED-6344). Will add dedupe and severity adjustments.

Maya: Proposed RACI: Dan (R), Maya (A), Rohit (C), Tara (I). @Dan can you be primary for rollout?

Dan: Yep. Pairing with @Tara for the deploy window and will be on-call the rollout day. :thumbsup:

Rohit: Filed RED-6343 and attached the rollback playbook draft. Adding tests for eviction thresholds.

Tara: Created RED-6344 and pushed initial dashboard panels. Requesting Grafana read for the owners.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved by Maya at 2026-03-10T08:12:00Z — severity lowered to P3.

Maya: Owners please paste PRs, rollout notes, and test artifacts into each Jira ticket by EOD Fri. Short checklist:
- link postmortem doc
- attach PRs
- add canary timeline & rollback criteria
- define success metrics (error-rate, cache-hit-rate)

Dan: Adding canary: Fri 11am PT, 30m window. Will post smoke logs after run.

Rohit: CI perf baselines running; will attach CSVs to RED-6343. Also opening epic RED-6401 to track weekly eviction spikes.

Tara: Alerts: adding 10m dedupe and lower sensitivity on transient spikes. Linking dashboards to RED-6401 for trend correlation.

Maya: If any blockers (access, CI flakiness), ping me directly. I'll update the postmortem with the RACI and action tracker once links are in. Thanks all. :pray:
